groups.problem: The age/timestamp validators check truthiness instead of key presence, so zero values bypass the mutual-exclusion check.
groups.rationale: All three point at the same validators and describe the same both-zero bypass, with the same fix: check key membership.

groups.problem: The trace item attribute keys query key leaves out the organization, so organizations with the same filters share cache entries.
groups.rationale: All five flag the same missing organization slug/id in the query key at the same lines.

groups.problem: The custom cell renderer fallback uses `if (cell)` instead of `cell !== undefined`, so valid falsy ReactNodes such as 0, an empty string or null fall back to the default renderer.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same falsy check in the same renderer, with the same fix.

groups.problem: The feature-flagged TableWidgetVisualization branch passes empty placeholder columns and data instead of the query results.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same empty-props bug at the same lines.

groups.problem: Consumers still read the removed Visualize.yAxes property after it was replaced with yAxis (seerSearch.tsx and exploreParams.tsx).
groups.rationale: It is the same incomplete migration of yAxes to yAxis, repeated in several consumers. S3 covers both places, and S13 and S14 each cover one.

problems: The age/timestamp validators check truthiness, so a report with both fields set to zero passes.
Both fields are optional, so a report with neither age nor timestamp passes validation.
uncoveredProblems: Validation does not require that exactly one of age/timestamp is present, so a report with neither field passes.
